summary.shortDescription: A regulated ARMOUR device with a built-in 5500 mAh battery and 100 W maximum output.
summary.description: VAPORESSO documents the ARMOUR ULTRA as a built-in-battery regulated device rated at 100 W. An exact-device Vaping360 review measured 101 W and 29 A and reached at least 7.97 V, explicitly noting that the voltage could be higher. The admitted runtime profile uses 7.97 V as a deliberately conservative observed proxy; it is not presented as the device's proven maximum.
highlights: Exact identity and integrated battery are established.
It is distinct from the cataloged dual-21700 ARMOUR MAX.
Independent testing supplies 101 W and 29 A and a 7.97 V-plus observation.
Runtime admission uses 7.97 V conservatively while preserving the unresolved true maximum.

claims.statement: The exact marketed identity is VAPORESSO ARMOUR ULTRA.
claims.limitations: Future revision or regional naming changes remain possible.

claims.statement: VAPORESSO specifies a built-in 5500 mAh battery and 100 W maximum output.
claims.limitations: Official presentations vary in listed dimensions and omit maximum output voltage/current.

claims.statement: The exact manual describes low-resistance protection below 0.1 Ω and high-resistance protection above 5 Ω.
claims.limitations: Protection thresholds are not necessarily a flat supported range in every operating mode.

claims.statement: Vaping360 measured about 101 W and 29 A on an exact ARMOUR ULTRA sample and observed at least 7.97 V.
claims.limitations: Single sample and test-load coverage; the voltage observation was open-ended.

claims.statement: The exact ARMOUR ULTRA review does not establish a maximum output voltage because the observed 7.97 V value was reported as 7.97 V plus.
claims.limitations: A runtime profile may use a deliberately conservative observed value only after an explicit policy decision; it must not be described as the device's true maximum.

claims.statement: ARMOUR ULTRA and ARMOUR MAX are members of VAPORESSO's ARMOUR family but use different battery architectures.
claims.limitations: Family membership does not permit transferring electrical limits.
